speaker: Anna
text: Hi Ben! Do you have any plans for Saturday?

speaker: Ben
text: Not yet. What would you like to do?

speaker: Anna
text: Let us have a picnic in the park. The weather will be sunny.

speaker: Ben
text: That sounds great! I can bring some sandwiches.

speaker: Anna
text: Perfect. I will bring fruit and drinks. Shall we meet at eleven?

speaker: Ben
text: Yes, eleven is good. Where shall we meet?

speaker: Anna
text: At the main entrance, near the big tree.

speaker: Ben
text: I know the place. Can I invite my sister?

speaker: Anna
text: Of course! The more, the merrier. See you on Saturday!
